== Old PC forum facts added (wave 2), 24 November 2026 ==
Added a Planning section (4 April 2006 announcement; 24–27 August dates; 6 May 2006 explanation of the move from GenCon; site choice; 25 and 31 May PasTimes updates; 15 June date change, vote and GenCon remarks) and a Qualifiers section, from Players Committee forum topics "Road to Worlds 2006", "Worlds Date" and "Qualifiers for Worlds 2006" (sources in the refs).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Store address: on 6 April 2006 Mike Carr gave it as 8478 W Golf Rd, Niles; Brandon Schele corrected it to 8351 Golf Rd (forum post 131145, forum post 131166). The infobox gives 8351½ Golf Road from the October 2006 forum header. Kept as is.
* Planned date: Carr gave 24–27 August 2006 (forum post 131145); on 27 May 2006 a player (DzSolid) referred to "the actual date (19th of August)" (forum post 138774). Not resolved; the article gives Carr's dates as "expected".
=== Left out ===
* The 24 June 2006 Arizona State Championship (Eloy Public Library) offering a bye into Day 2 (forum post 140562): the only capture is a page whose topic title is not recoverable here, and the fact belongs on an Arizona event page.
* The qualifier list never says "Day 2", so the Qualifiers section does not either.
* The PasTimes contact's first name (first name only).
* Booker's and other players' comments in the Worlds Date topic (opinion).
